## 1. Guidance and results

- Q3 2026 revenue was $24.4B (+39%) and non-GAAP EPS was $7.48. FY2026 revenue guidance was raised to $91–92B from $85–87B. The midpoint rise is $5.5B. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lilly-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full-year-guidance-and-highlights-regulatory-progress-across-the-portfolio-302922907.html
- Non-GAAP EPS guidance is now $35.00–36.00, down from $35.50–36.50. Underlying EPS guidance rose $4.07 at the midpoint, but $4.57 of Q3 acquired IPR&D charges more than offset it. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/eli-lilly-lly-earnings-q3-2026.html
- Versus LSEG consensus, EPS was $7.48 vs $6.26 expected and revenue was $24.40B vs $22.61B expected. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/eli-lilly-lly-earnings-q3-2026.html
- A Hudson Labs preview showed a different consensus of $22.36B revenue. — date unknown — https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/eli-lilly-q3-2026-earnings-preview-lly-revenue-eps-preview
- Q3 revenue included about $900M of one-time-type benefits. These were $410M of Jardiance milestones (none remain) plus favorable rebate and discount adjustments. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000005947826000104/q326lillysalesandearningsp.htm
- Volume rose 53% and realized prices fell 15%. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/lilly-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full-year-guidance-and-highlights-regulatory-progress-across-the-portfolio
- This is the third guidance raise this year. The stock rose more than 4% premarket. — 2026-10-29 — https://qz.com/eli-lilly-raises-outlook-third-time-zepbound-102926

## 3. Litigation and regulation

- Lilly filed five lawsuits against online retailers, a weight-loss clinic and a med spa over products sold as retatrutide. — 2026-10-08 — https://www.bipc.com/eli-lillys-retatrutide-lawsuits-what-pharmacies-telemedicine-companies-and-online-retailers-need-to-know
- Bloomberg Law counts at least 11 federal suits against retatrutide copycat sellers so far. — 2026-10-26 (article date; individual filing dates unknown) — https://news.bloomberglaw.com/health-law-and-business/eli-lilly-toughens-legal-game-plan-over-next-weight-loss-drug
- FDA approvals cited in the Q3 release: Mounjaro for cardiovascular risk reduction, Onswik (weekly basal insulin), Inluriyo with Verzenio, and an expanded Jaypirca indication. — date unknown — https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/lilly-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full-year-guidance-and-highlights-regulatory-progress-across-the-portfolio
- The GLP-1 product-liability MDL (E.D. Pa.) shows 4,025 pending cases as of October 2026. This is from an aggregator. — date unknown — https://www.drugwatch.com/legal/mounjaro-lawsuit/
- I found no new government investigations, fines or antitrust actions against Lilly in the window.

## 4. Customer concentration

- Lilly relies on McKesson, Cencora and Cardinal Health for distribution. This is a Motley Fool characterization, and I found no percentage-of-revenue figure. — 2026-10-22 (article date) — https://www.fool.com/coverage/better-buy/2026/10/22/amgen-vs-eli-lilly-does-the-glp-1-mania-make-lly-stock-a-better-buy-in-2026/
- CVS Caremark adds other weight-loss drugs alongside Wegovy to its largest commercial formularies. Per Novo's filing, this takes effect 2026-10-01. — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000353278/000035327826000023/caq22026.htm
- CNBC reports employer plans are dropping GLP-1 coverage for 2027. — 2026-10-27 (article date) — https://cnbc.com/2026/10/27/glp1-drug-coverage-weight-loss-options.html
- No material customer wins or losses beyond the above.

## 5. Insider activity

- I found no Form 4 transactions dated 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-29.
- Lilly Endowment (largest shareholder) filed a Form 144 to sell 300,000 shares (~$347M) via J.P. Morgan. The transaction date is not given; the article is dated 2026-10-09. 24/7 Wall St. describes it as a required annual charity payout. — https://yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/eli-lilly-biggest-shareholder-just-132032737.html

  - Hakim: 5,000 shares at $1,190 — 2026-08-07 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000168555626000006/wk-form4_1786393159.xml
  - Zakrowski: 2,000 shares at $1,185.01 — 2026-08-10 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000005947826000083/wk-form4_1786480313.xml
  - Jonsson: 6,500 shares at $1,175.10 — 2026-08-17 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000178605426000006/wk-form4_1787084453.xml
- Hakim's plan covers up to 10,000 shares through 2026-11-30. — plan adopted 2026-02-10 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000005947826000045/lly-20260331.htm

## 6. Product and competitive news

- Mounjaro revenue was $10.7B (+65%) and Zepbound was $5.35B (+49%), versus a $5.09B Zepbound consensus. — 2026-10-29 — https://qz.com/eli-lilly-raises-outlook-third-time-zepbound-102926
- Foundayo (oral obesity pill, launched in April) had $184M of Q3 sales, below the ~$229M StreetAccount estimate. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/eli-lilly-lly-earnings-q3-2026.html
- Retatrutide delivered more than double the weight loss of Ozempic 2 mg in a head-to-head Phase 3 trial in type 2 diabetes. — date unknown — https://www.benzinga.com/news/health-care/26/10/62654661/eli-lilly-says-retatrutide-delivers-more-than-double-ozempics-weight-loss-in-late-stage-diabetes-trial
- Lilly plans to file retatrutide for obesity in Q1 2027. Novo's CagriSema is the only competing next-generation candidate already filed. — date unknown — https://qz.com/next-weight-loss-drugs-2026
- Other pipeline items:
  - Phase 2 EloraTZP results, with Phase 3 starting in Q4 2026.
  - Phase 3 Ebglyss data in hand-and-foot atopic dermatitis.
  - The AtaiBeckley acquisition is complete, and the Merida Biosciences acquisition closed after quarter end.
  - Dates for all of these are unknown. — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000059478/000005947826000104/q326lillysalesandearningsp.htm
- Self-pay pricing: Zepbound starts at $299 a month, while Novo's Wegovy starts at $149 for the pill and $199 for the shot. — 2026-10-27 (article date) — https://cnbc.com/2026/10/27/glp1-drug-coverage-weight-loss-options.html

writeup.headline: Eli Lilly rates Strong Buy on rapid growth, high gross margins, strong trend and raised guidance.
writeup.thesis: Lilly scores 84, a Strong Buy, driven mainly by a very strong price trend (97) and high quality (94). The shares are 18.4% above their 200-day average, 42.8 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days and only 1.4% below their 52-week high. Quality rests on a gross margin of 83.4%, stock-based pay of 0.8% of revenue and diluted share count down 0.7% year on year. Growth scores 77 on TTM revenue growth of 49.6%, though growth slowed by 7.9 pp from the previous quarter. News is supportive (68): Lilly raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $91–92B for the third time this year. Balance sheet and valuation had no score here. P/S of 15.2x is high in absolute terms but near the middle of its own history.
key_risks: Growth is decelerating: latest-quarter revenue growth of 47.7% year on year, with growth slowed by 7.9 pp from the previous quarter.
P/S of 15.2x is high in absolute terms, leaving little room for disappointment.
Competition in obesity drugs, including Novo's cheaper self-pay pricing and the Foundayo pill launch missing estimates.
The GLP-1 product-liability MDL and copycat retatrutide sellers are ongoing legal background risks.
After a strong run (shares up 44.2% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago), the price is extended at 8.1% above its 50-day average.
what_would_change: The score is 5 points above the Buy band (below 80); a further slowdown in revenue growth or a weaker trend score could tip it down.
A pullback that erodes the 97 trend score, such as the price falling back toward its 200-day average, would weigh on the rating.
Negative guidance or competitive news, such as share loss to Novo or pricing pressure, would cut the 68 news score.
Once scored, the balance sheet and valuation factors could move the composite either way.
